The drawing is diclazuril.

**Triazine ring.** Going round the ring: N2 (attached to the aryl group), N1 (=CH), C6H, C5(=O), N4H, C3(=O) back to N2. Starting from the aryl-bearing N, this reads as n1 N=CC(=O)NC1=O.

**Central aryl ring.** It carries the triazine N at the para position and two Cl atoms ortho to the CH(CN)Ar carbon.

**Side chain.** The benzylic carbon bears a nitrile (C#N) and a 4-chlorophenyl group. It is drawn with plain bonds, so no stereochemistry is given.

SMILES: N#CC(c1ccc(Cl)cc1)c1c(Cl)cc(cc1Cl)N1N=CC(=O)NC1=O
